subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw expose this lease-bound external-orchestrator session contract as a permanent core Gateway API, or should the integration own the Agentic-OS-specific workflow behind a generic plugin-facing seam?
rationale: The patch adds a broad public protocol, persistent state, and privileged spawn authorization rather than repairing an established contract; repository policy requires a maintainer decision for this owner boundary.

options.title: Define a generic core seam first
options.body: Approve only a narrow, owner-neutral authorization/session extension point and keep Agentic-OS-specific RPC names, metadata, and orchestration behavior in its integration.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Explicitly accept the new Gateway methods as supported core API, then require versioning, security ownership, compatibility documentation, and focused upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Define a generic core seam first
recommendation.body: Approve only a narrow, owner-neutral authorization/session extension point and keep Agentic-OS-specific RPC names, metadata, and orchestration behavior in its integration.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-level owner is needed to decide whether this becomes permanent core Gateway surface.
